system.description: The sorcerer conjures a storm of razor-edged obsidian butterfly-shapes from the Essence of the air and sends them hurtling across the landscape. The blades appear in front of the sorcerer and speed away from him in a 100-yard wide, (Essence x 10)-yard long swath. Everything in this swath takes 20 levels of lethal damage. This damage can be soaked with armored soak only — natural soak does not apply. The butterflies can be dodged (difficulty 3), but they cannot be parried. The butterflies cannot be stopped by cover of 2 or fewer dots.
